# KothaKhoj.com

> Nepal's modern real estate marketplace. Buy, rent, and sell homes, apartments, land, and commercial property in Kathmandu, Pokhara, Lalitpur and beyond.

KothaKhoj.com connects property owners directly with buyers and renters across Nepal. Listings are verified and cover every major city and district.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Featured and latest property listings across Nepal.
- [Buy Properties](/buy): Houses, apartments, land and villas for sale, filterable by city, district, price and property type.
- [Rent Properties](/rent): Apartments, rooms and family homes for rent across Nepal.
- [Sell Your Property](/sell): List a property for sale or rent on KothaKhoj.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the KothaKhoj team.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable pages including individual property listings.
